title: SQL for Financial Analysts
subtitle: PostgreSQL — still the core skill
learningOutcomes: Query a PostgreSQL database from Python with SQLAlchemy
SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING and ORDER BY fluently
Join tables and choose the join type deliberately
Use window functions for ranks, running totals and shares
Translate any query to its pandas twin and verify results match

biasCheck.prompt: An INNER JOIN can commit survivorship bias in one keyword. Explain how, using the clients/transactions tables.

green.prompt: Table schemas: [paste]. Write a PostgreSQL query answering: [business question]. Use a CTE if it needs more than one step, and explain the query.

red.why: A wrong JOIN or missing WHERE returns confident, wrong numbers
red.rule: Check row counts at each step and hand-verify one group before believing the answer

streamConnector.corporateFinance: ERP and ledger data is queried in SQL before it ever reaches a spreadsheet
streamConnector.assetManagement: Client and holdings systems are relational databases
streamConnector.banking: Core banking is SQL all the way down; every scorecard starts with a query
streamConnector.markets: Trade and order repositories are queried in SQL for surveillance and TCA
